owner_rules: Done means ALL evidence: implemented as specified (task id), a test that FAILED before and passes now, suites green, measured number vs target, docs regenerated, committed AND pushed to the contract's branch.
Never defer: no "later", "follow-up", "out of scope". If blocked: what blocks, what you tried, what you need; then continue with the next task.
Root cause, then fix: file:line + mechanism. No weakening tests, raising timeouts, skips, relaxed assertions.
No silent scope cuts: never lower targets, caps or test sizes without owner approval.
Never bypass guards: no --no-verify, no bypass env vars, no skip flags.
Deliver continuously: one task per commit, pushed to the contract's branch as it goes green.
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | measured vs target | missing.

tasks.title: Decision record
requirements: permission denial and attempted access outside the approved workspace;
UI refresh, reconnection and restart while events are arriving, ensuring the workspace reconstructs the same authoritative state;
stale or out-of-order events, ensuring views do not regress or show a false current status;
revoked folder, GitHub or provider permissions while work is queued or executing;
provider failure during a task, ensuring safe internal retry, reassignment or escalation according to policy.
Recovery must preserve history and surface unresolved conflicts; it must not silently convert uncertainty into deletion, success or last-write-wins.

criteria.statement: The record decides requirement 1: missing, corrupt or unreadable evidence;
The record decides requirement 2: permission denial and attempted access outside the approved workspace;
The record decides requirement 3: UI refresh, reconnection and restart while events are arriving, ensuring the workspace reconstructs the same authoritative state;
The record decides requirement 4: stale or out-of-order events, ensuring views do not regress or show a false current status;
The record decides requirement 5: revoked folder, GitHub or provider permissions while work is queued or executing;
The record decides requirement 6: provider failure during a task, ensuring safe internal retry, reassignment or escalation according to policy.
The record decides requirement 7: Recovery must preserve history and surface unresolved conflicts; it must not silently convert uncertainty into deletion, success or last-write-wins.
The record names the fault class table
The record names the test names
The decision record passes the leak scan
The documentation links and up-links stay valid

stop_rules: If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.
